changes: Added a reusable market-data parser and callable main(argv=None).
Unified ingestion dispatch now invokes the imported market-data module without runpy fallback.
Standalone and unified argument forwarding and help output match for World Bank and explicit seed modes.
Ingestion dispatcher restores the caller's sys.argv after successful execution and parser errors.
Invalid source and World Bank date filters are rejected before ingestion side effects.

market_data_pytest.command: python3 -m pytest tests/test_market_data_cli.py tests/test_market_data.py tests/test_market_data_recovery.py tests/test_market_data_worker.py -q

limitations: Does not establish populated price-data parity or live World Bank provider behavior.
Does not enable the isolated scheduled worker or close MAN-CAP-040/047 acceptance.
